==== tluaColonCallArityMessages.tlua (11 errors) ====
    // A colon call passes its receiver as the implicit first argument, so the
    // effective argument list the checker matches against the signature is one
    // longer than the source. An arity message counts what was WRITTEN, or it
    // describes an argument list the reader cannot see: `text:upper(1)` takes no
    // written arguments at all, so "expected 1, got 2" names neither the slot the
    // user can fill nor the argument they typed.
    
    local text: string = "hello";
